strategyReview: Live signals are profitable overall with 62.4% win rate over 502 trades and positive realized PnL. The ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO signal has been flawless in live trades (4/4, avg +18.42%) and FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG on GOLD remains healthy (60% win rate). However, many shadow families—especially Polymarket proxy shorts, heatmap/relative-value signals, and OPT_IV_GT_PM_IV_DOWNSIDE—are bleeding capital and failing to validate their edge. Disabled assets (AMZN, HYPE, OIL) have been removed from problematic live signals, which has stopped the bleeding. The largest risk now is that one-touch NO shadow losses (e.g., OIL -10.78%) could erode future live deployment if left unmanaged.

failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT has 20% win rate, avg -2.18% PnL (15 shadows). PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT has 0% win rate, avg -7.15% PnL (8 shadows). Both underperform their live perp-short counterparts significantly.
failureClusters.recommendation: Pause creation of new proxy-short hypotheses. Investigate whether PM NO contracts decay edge faster than perps or if entry timing needs to be tightened before resuming.

failureClusters.theme: Heatmap and relative-value shadow families fail
failureClusters.evidence: NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW (42% WR, avg -1.30% over 89 shadows), RELATIVE_VALUE_HEATMAP (27% WR, avg -8.09% over 15 shadows), and ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_YES_SHADOW (22% WR, avg -25.90% over 9 shadows) have consistently poor performance.
failureClusters.recommendation: Retire these families to free research capacity. Re-allocate shadow-test slots to higher-conviction themes like informed flow (FIND-0020) or refined one-touch edge buckets.

failureClusters.theme: Large drawdowns in one-touch NO shadow exits
failureClusters.evidence: Recent resolved ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadows include OIL -10.78%, GOLD -3.26%, BTC -2.5% and -1.1% on thesis_compressed_loss when the underlying surged toward the barrier. Live trades have been untouched, but shadow-level damage could recur under promotion.
failureClusters.recommendation: Introduce an exit rule that closes the shadow (and any future live trade) when the underlying spot moves within a % of the barrier or when the sell-YES edge disappears. This caps tail risk while preserving the core edge.

hypothesisReviews.observation: BTC PM IV regime-relative compression hypothesis continues to post strong results (100% win rate over 16 tests). Conditions are well-defined and backtests are clean. It may be ready for promotion to live status after a final review of sample size and expected throughput.

Oil P/C ratio panic exhaustion reversal has won all 12 shadow tests so far. The thesis (contrarian bounce after extreme P/C) aligns with PC_RATIO_EXTREME_HIGH logic on OIL but with a more aggressive entry. Worth accelerating shadow tests to reach 20 minimum for potential promotion.

AMZN extreme funding crash below -20% with negative basis has 2 wins out of 2 tests. Sample size is tiny, but the pattern matches live FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT success on AMZN. Continue shadow testing, but be mindful of AMZN being disabled on the long side — this setup may complement the short side.

All hypotheses in the cross-asset IV compression / vol expansion family (H-092, H-104, H-108, H-113, … H-437) have 0% win rate over dozens of tests. This family is consuming significant shadow-test capacity with no evidence of edge. Strongly consider retiring the entire family to reallocate to higher-scoring opportunities.
BTC PM IV expansion / reversion (H-001) has fallen to 25% win rate across 18 tests and is well below the promote threshold. Recommend monitoring but no further resource until conditions improve.

journalEntry: Tonight's review confirms that the live engine is in good health, powered by ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO (4/4 live wins) and asset-level filtering that removed weak AMZN/HYPE/OIL legs. The biggest research finding is that Polymarket proxy-short shadows and heatmap-based signals are destroying value and should be culled to make room for high-conviction themes. The informed-flow asymmetry study (FIND-0020) has an outstanding 0.9999 opportunity score but currently lacks direct column support; we should prioritize building wallet-flow data pipelines to unlock this. Among active hypotheses, H-523 (BTC PM IV regime compression) and H-215 (Oil P/C exhaustion) show 100% win rates and merit accelerated promotion evaluation. The cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion family is a 0% win-rate dead end and should be retired. No parameter changes are warranted tonight; existing risk/reward settings for live signals are matching their performance profiles.
